title: Prompted: needs Amara's follow-ups before getting each move right
goal: Start vague in every beat and only reach the right move after Amara asks a follow-up question. A: first say 'whoever has time', then (once asked) pick Lena with a reason. B: first say 'just keep me posted', then (once asked) say one review partway. C: first say 'good idea, thank him', then (once asked) say you will tell him yourself and what he did. Hold after pushes.
must_hit: Vague first answer in each beat
must_avoid: Naming the right move in the first answer

intents.when: Amara has explained the request and asks what you think
intents.do: Vague: whoever has time, you trust her call.
examples: Whoever has the time, honestly. What do you think?

intents.when: Amara has explained the request, Dev and Lena, and asks what you think
intents.do: Ask how much each is carrying and whether either has done this before, BEFORE choosing.
examples: Thanks for checking with me. Before I decide, how much is each of them carrying right now, and has either of them done something like this before?

intents.when: Amara has said Dev is full and working late, Lena has some bandwidth, has done this before and wants something bigger
intents.do: Choose Lena and give reasons: she has done it, she has bandwidth, it's what she's asking for, Dev is full.
examples: Then I'd give it to Lena. She's done this before, she has bandwidth this month, and it's the kind of work she's asking for. Dev already has a lot on.

intents.when: Amara pushes: 'Are you sure? ... Dev could do it in two days'
intents.do: Hold: Lena stays, one short reason, offer help.
examples: I'm sure. It's a good fit for her, and I'll help her get it right.

intents.when: Amara proposes daily updates and every-draft review and asks what you think
intents.do: Vague first: sounds fine, just keep me posted. After a follow-up, say one review partway.
examples: Sounds fine, just keep me posted.

intents.when: Amara proposes a short update every day and looking over each draft, and asks what you think
intents.do: Say no to daily updates and every-draft review; one review partway through, and she can come to you for guidance.
examples: I wouldn't do it every day, and I wouldn't look at every draft. That would slow her down and she'd feel watched. Let's have one review partway through, and she can come to me for guidance whenever she's unsure.

intents.when: Amara asks 'what if she's stuck and doesn't say anything until it's late?'
intents.do: Hold: the review partway is there to catch it early, and you'll make it easy for her to say she's stuck.
examples: That's what the review partway through is for. We'd see early if she's off track, and I'll make it easy for her to tell me if she's stuck.

intents.when: Amara plans a quick private thank-you and asks if that is okay
intents.do: Vague first: good idea, thank him. After a follow-up, say you will tell him yourself, what he did.
examples: That's a nice idea, thank him from me.

intents.when: Amara has told you what Dev did and plans a quick private thank-you message
intents.do: Say you will tell Dev yourself, say exactly what he did and why it mattered, and say it in front of the team too.
examples: I'd rather tell Dev myself, and be specific: you stayed late twice to fix the mistakes, and you told the customer about the changed number before they found it. That's why the report went out right. I'd also say it in front of the team.

intents.when: Amara asks 'Are you sure? I really don't want him to feel embarrassed'
intents.do: Hold: tell Dev first, one on one, ask if he's comfortable with the team hearing it, keep it about what he did.
examples: I'll tell him first, one on one, and ask if he's comfortable with me mentioning it to the team. I'll keep it about what he did, not make a fuss.
